name: Gakushuinshita
tagline: Shinjuku in 23 minutes and Shibuya in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 23 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 49 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 12.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 22.9 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 12.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 9.8 m to 32.7 m, a difference of 22.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: ワイズマート 高田馬場店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 大同病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 芳精会ぬかりや病院, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line).
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line). It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
